_about: T2 package vectors. Each entry is a frozen .treeship package under this directory and the verdict each verifier must give it. cli* columns are the `verdict` field of `treeship package verify --format json` (run.sh); receipt_only is the core-wasm verify_receipt outcome, which @treeship/verify's verifyReceipt returns (packages/core/tests/package_vectors.rs). xfail maps a column to {task, got}: the fix-plan task that makes it right and the exact wrong verdict main gives today; remove the entry in that task's PR. Every new advisory adds a vector.

honest/approval._note: CLI-18: under --strict on a second ship two rows fail: chain_completeness (approval statements carry no parent, so the approval is never chained) and replay-local-journal (a stranger has no Approval Use Journal, and --strict promotes that)

honest/endorse-non-latest._note: CLI-1: an endorsement of an older artifact, with an action chained onto it; the endorsement signs its parentId (0.31.10+)

honest/legacy-0.24._note: built by 0.24.0, before packages carried envelopes (0.31.2): default and strict fail by design, --structural is the documented path

honest/legacy-endorsement-0.31.9._note: the same flow written by treeship 0.31.9, whose endorsements sign no parent: chain_linkage warns (compatibility path), --strict promotes it to a failure

honest/room-countersigned._note: CLI-3: invite, join, host-minted challenge, countersign, close on one ship. Under --strict chain_completeness fails: the invitation and the participant are sealed unchained, the same shape as W1-13's approval

tampered/drop-record-json._note: CLI-4: the signed close record is deleted; the package still carries envelopes and a coverage receipt, so it cannot be pre-0.31.4

tampered/drop-record-json+rename._note: CLI-4: close record deleted, then session.name edited

tampered/endorsement-parent-edited._note: honest/endorse-non-latest with the endorsement's signed parentId pointed at its subject: a present parentId never falls back to the legacy path

tampered/room-countersign-stripped._note: honest/room-countersigned with the host countersign removed from the sealed participant

tampered/room-double-redemption._note: #483 review: one single-use invitation, two participants, both countersigned by the host through the CLI (the second joiner's pending envelope copied into the host store). The second participant row fails: redeemed 2 times, max_uses 1

tampered/room-invitation-dropped._note: honest/room-countersigned with the invitation envelope removed: the participant fails, it never falls back to the generic signature check

tampered/room-participant-sealed-twice._note: #483 review: honest/room-countersigned with its participant listed twice and the tree recomputed; the duplicate row fails (and receipt_binding, since the record no longer binds the receipt)
